messages:
ben: Quick heads-up  Greenfield Learning signed an ISV listing on Azure Marketplace and chose Redwood Dedicated for inference. Went live this morning. :tada:

lara: Amazing! any early metrics from the integration tests?

ben: Pilot highlights: search rerank latency down ~30% using prefix cache + quantized model; embedding batch throughput improved ~1.6x. They selected reserved Dedicated capacity in eu-north-1.

emily: Marketing note: we'll need a 2-sentence customer quote + a short technical blurb for the marketplace spotlight. Can product/security approve?

tom: Ops update: they required BYOK + 60-day audit retention. INF-4622 created and assigned. VPC peering configured.

deploy-bot: Azure Marketplace listing active: https://portal.azure.com/marketplace/items/greenfield-learning/embed-suite status=ACTIVE.

sylvia: Sales requested a reference tag for renewal playbooks: REF-GREEN-07. Added to CRM.

emily: Quick draft bullets for blog: 1) Marketplace listing + Dedicated reserved capacity. 2) 30% latency improvement for rerank flows. 3) Security: BYOK + audit logs.

ben: I'll set up a 15-min quote call with their CTO tomorrow at 9am CET. Sending invite and consent form.

sales-bot: Reference added: REF-GREEN-07.

lara: Tiny engineering snippet for the tech blog:

```
redwood.reserve_capacity(
  customer="greenfield",
  pool="dedicated-eu-north-1",
  instances=5,
  model="embed-lite-1b",
  quant_variant="int8"
)
```

ben: Great work team. Marketing will share the draft for review by EOD. Congrats! :rocket:
